tasks.gr9-visual-arts-t3: Topic: Visual Arts. Cover identity and environment as themes, mixed media techniques and materials, symbolism and symbolic meaning, personal expression, artist statements, critique and feedback, composition supporting theme, and reflective analysis. Ask Grade 9 learners to explain theme choices, analyze symbols, justify media selections, write artist statements, provide constructive critique, and reflect on compositional decisions.
tasks.gr9-music-t3: Topic: Music. Cover binary (AB) and ternary (ABA) form analysis, composition and arrangement basics, ostinato patterns and repetition, technology in music production (DAWs, effects), rehearsal independence and initiative, score analysis, and form listening strategies. Ask Grade 9 learners to identify musical forms, arrange simple material, create ostinato patterns, use technology creatively, analyze form structures, and lead own rehearsal.
tasks.gr9-drama-t3: Topic: Drama. Cover script writing and adaptation, character motivation and backstory, rehearsal discipline and focus, collaborative ensemble work, peer review and feedback, stage direction clarity, mood creation through all elements, and scene development. Ask Grade 9 learners to write or adapt scenes, justify character choices, lead rehearsals, give peer feedback, clarify stage directions, and analyze scene effectiveness.
tasks.gr9-dance-t3: Topic: Dance. Cover group choreography creation and development, smooth transitions and connections, maintaining expressive intent throughout, rehearsal documentation and logs, ensemble discipline and consistency, self-evaluation and reflection, performance gaps identification, and linking movement sections. Ask Grade 9 learners to choreograph group pieces, describe transitions, maintain intent, document rehearsal, evaluate performance, identify improvement areas, and reflect on ensemble work.
